verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that users edit, orchestrate and build entirely in natural language across the CLI and IDE. They also document natural-language code commands, spoken prompts converted into prompts, and agents that autonomously act across the editor, terminal and browser. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that natural-language commanding works reliably, and evidence that product configuration (permissions, settings) can be driven by natural language rather than slash commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Edit, orchestrate, and build all in natural language. Tell your agents what you need, and they’ll work on getting it done.
Google Antigravity's Editor view offers tab autocompletion, natural language code commands
real-time transcription converts conversational speech into clearly phrased prompts
Able to autonomously operate across your editor, terminal, and browser.
you can provide inline text feedback to steer the agent’s thinking in the proper direction before it modifies any local files
